title: Mechanical demolition equipment.
officialText:
Where mechanical demolition equipment, other than handheld devices, is to be used in
the full or partial demolition of a building or structure, or is to be used to remove debris or move material, approval of the
commissioner for the use of the mechanical demolition equipment must be obtained prior to the commencement of demolition
operations.
